无论他们是选择在需要的时候团结在一起，还是反目成仇，他们现在的决定对于未来朝着哪个方向发展都会产生很大的影响。

texts.en:
The settlements on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been experiencing agricultural difficulties. Recent crop failures could lead to conflicts over food. This is a critical moment in the development of a young society.

Whether they choose to come together in their time of need, or to turn against each other, their decisions now will have a strong bearing on who they ultimately become.

Unfortunately, no matter which course is taken, they are entering a period of extreme hardship.

label.zh: 我们不会打扰他们的自然发展历程。
label.en: We will not interfere with the natural course of their development.

label.zh: 我们在道义上应该帮助。
label.en: We have a moral obligation to help.

label.zh: 我们可以降低他们对食物的需求……
label.en: We will reduce their need for food...

texts.zh:
我们最近对[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的干预产生了正面的结果。利用我们自己的农业技术，我们暗中确保了他们不会遭受饥荒。

现在，他们有了盈余的食物，所以我们必须约束自己的行径，限制干预的程度。
texts.en:
Our recent intervention on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] yielded positive results. Utilizing our own agricultural technologies, we covertly ensured they would not starve.

Now, they have a surplus of food, so it is only right that we limit the extent of our interference by taking some for ourselves.
